ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a ratio of approximately 98:2 black to white pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black mass covering the entire visible ventral area, punctuated by small white circular spots (diameter 3-8 pixels) primarily clustered on the distal half of the right lobe and sporadically on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 140 degrees and a depth relative to the lobe tips of approximately 15% of the total vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (2-5 pixel depth) throughout the visible boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric outward and upward concave sweep originating from the notch, transitioning to a convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately 15 high-contrast white circular spots located on the upper-right distal lobe; a secondary smaller cluster of 3-4 spots visible on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular, brownish-pink textured mass located on the far distal tip of the left fluke, significantly altering the expected geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of individual white barnacle-like protrusions along the trailing edge and concentrated at the far right distal tip.
